items.briefing:
Australian ed-tech platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting more than one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information has been exposed, making this highly relevant to anyone in the education sector, including registered training organisations. If you or your organisation uses Mathspace, be alert for phishing emails or suspicious contact using your personal details.

More broadly, scammers are increasingly using personal data from breaches to make fraudulent calls and messages appear legitimate. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected call or email claiming to be from a platform you use, do not click links or share information — contact the organisation directly using details from their official website.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
